name: open-tgate
description: Read authorized Telegram multi-account inbox, contacts, captured deletion/edit history, audit logs and approved business knowledge through Open-TGate OAuth.

interface.longDescription: Connect your authorized Open-TGate operator workspace using OAuth. Inspect connected Telegram accounts, inbox history, contacts, captured deleted-message snapshots, edit and connection audit events, and approved knowledge. Read-only; no Telegram sending or login credentials are exposed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my connected Telegram accounts and recent audit events.
